purpose: Make AIGC phases 2 through 24 visible inside the pipeline by producing an ordered, dependency-aware, safety-gated continuity ledger before Phase 25 and Phase 26 artifact stages run.

phase2.reason: Opportunity radar can be read-only but still touches external public sources, so it remains explicit-run gated.

phase3.reason: Ology assessment needs a Phase 2 queue.

phase5.reason: Authorization packets and approval decisions must remain human-controlled.

phase6.reason: Controlled execution requires approved Phase 5 packets and still performs no hidden external execution.

phase7.reason: Audit packet generation requires execution receipts or manual handoff records.

phase8.reason: Evolution proposals must not silently alter behavior.

phase10.reason: Connector governance can produce internal registry records.

phase11.reason: Security vault checks must never log secret values.

phase13.reason: Simulation and replay must remain synthetic or read-only.

phase14.reason: Runtime preflight checks readiness and blocks external action.

phase15.reason: Finance/contracts ledger depends on proposal packages.

phase16.reason: Compliance review depends on proposal packages and is not legal advice.

phase17.reason: Incident response records internal events only.

phase18.reason: Productization readiness is an internal release check.

phase19.reason: Sub-agent planning depends on proposal packages.

phase20.reason: Fidelity review depends on sub-agent plans.

phase21.reason: Customer satisfaction scoring depends on fidelity reviews.

phase22.reason: Quality kernel consumes customer satisfaction records.

phase23.reason: Work order governance consumes quality kernel records.

phase24.reason: Autonomic business pipeline consumes work order governance records.
